value.name: notices father's frailty
value.description: Asha observes her father's breathing, trembling lip, and graying hairline, registering how much he has aged.
evidence: the way his breathing caught and resumed, the small tremor in his lower lip, the gray at the edge of his hairline she had not seen up close in years

value.name: reads Rosa's message
value.description: Asha sees Rosa's text urging her to photograph her father's hand so she can remember its texture later.
evidence: Her phone lit against her thigh with a message from Rosa—take a photo of his hand, you'll remember the texture later—and she read it without moving her own hand

value.name: chooses not to take photo
value.description: Asha puts her phone face down beside her instead of photographing her father's hand.
evidence: then put the phone face down on the blanket beside her without taking the picture

value.name: reviews facility list
value.description: Asha takes out the folded list of care facilities and studies the rates.
evidence: The list of facilities was still folded in the bag at her feet
Asha slid her hand off her father's and reached down for the bag, drawing out the folded sheet and smoothing it across her knee so the rates lined up in their small careful column

value.name: fixates on cheapest facility
value.description: Asha's attention settles on the cheapest facility, near Marcus in a town she has never driven to.
evidence: Her finger went to the cheapest one almost on its own, the one near Marcus in a town she had never driven to, and stayed there long enough for the paper to warm under it

value.name: weighs closer options
value.description: Asha considers the nearer facilities and mentally repeats the arithmetic she already did, finding the answer unchanged.
evidence: She thought about the closer two, the hour from her apartment, and did the arithmetic she had already done in the administrator's office; the answer had not changed

value.name: calls Marcus
value.description: Asha picks up her phone, ignores Rosa's message and years of missed birthdays, and dials Marcus.
evidence: She picked up the phone from the blanket, scrolled past Rosa's unanswered message and a decade of birthdays she had let pass without dialing, and pressed Marcus's name before she could put the sheet away

value.name: waits for Marcus to answer
value.description: The call begins ringing while Asha's father continues breathing beside her, unaware she is about to speak to his son after ten years.
evidence: The line began to ring, and her father went on breathing beside her, unaware that she was about to speak to his son for the first time in ten years
value.time_hint: for the first time in ten years
